resources.string:
VegamShare starts a helper through Wireless debugging (Android 11+). No PC or root.

1. Tap Start. Wireless debugging opens. (No Developer options? Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times.)

2. Turn on Wireless debugging and tap "Pair device with pairing code".

3. Type the 6 digits on the floating number pad (or in the VegamShare notification). VegamShare comes back by itself.

After a restart just turn Wireless debugging on; no code needed.
Use split screen so the Wireless debugging pairing code stays open, then enter the IP:port and 6-digit code shown there.
Enter the pairing port shown on your phone.
Connecting to ADB and starting server…
Helper started. You can now send and receive apps with their data.\n\nAfter a restart, just turn on Wireless debugging and tap Setup again; no code needed.
Enter the code in this screen instead
Open Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code.
Pairing service found. Remember the 6-digit code from Settings, then tap Enter code (the keyboard may cover it).
The pairing code screen was closed. Open it again and keep it open (use the notification or split screen).
Pairing failed. Check the 6-digit code and try again.
Turn on Wireless debugging; VegamShare starts by itself. If it asks for a code, tap \"Pair device with pairing code\".
VegamShare needs a one-time setup via Wireless debugging to access Android/data. Tap Setup to begin — takes about a minute and works without a PC.
There is no second space on this phone yet.
Turn on Settings → Apps → Dual apps for any app once (or create Second space). Then come back here.
Turn on Settings → Apps → App cloner for any app once. Then come back here.
Turn on Settings → Apps → App clone for any app once. Then come back here.
Samsung only clones messaging apps. Create Secure Folder (Settings → Security) or a work profile instead, then come back here.
Create PrivateSpace (Settings → Privacy) or a work profile, then come back here.
Create a work profile (for example with the Shelter or Island app) or, on Android 15+, Private space. Then come back here.
No games or apps with downloaded data were found.
Copies the game\'s downloaded data (obb and Android/data/…/files). Logins, settings, screenshots, logs and cache are not copied, so the clone can log in with another account.
Copy the game data too, so the clone does not download it again?
Remove %1$s from %2$s? Its data there (including that account\'s login) is deleted. The app on this phone is not touched.
VegamShare closes %1$s in %2$s, then copies %3$s of game data from this phone. The original is only read, never changed.
Android creates the clone\'s data folder the first time it opens. Open %1$s in %2$s, wait for the loading or download screen (do not download), close it and come back.
Could not open it from here. Open %1$s in %2$s yourself, then tap Copy data again.
Copied %1$s (%2$s). %3$s were already up to date.
Stopped. What was copied stays; Update data continues from there.
The clone\'s data folder is missing. Open the clone once and try again.
These apps in %s also open links or files, so Android asks which space to use and cannot remember it (\"Always\" is grey). Remove them from that space only; this phone keeps them.
No app in %s competes for links or files.
Done. Open a file again and choose Always.
Starting %1$s in the second space once so Android creates its data folder. It closes again by itself.\n\nIf the phone asks which app to open, pick the one marked as the clone.
This phone already has a newer version of the app. Uninstall it first, or update the app on the sending phone.
The phone blocks installing over debugging. On Xiaomi/POCO turn on Developer options → Install via USB, then try again.
The app on this phone is signed differently (another source). Uninstall it first, then try again.
This phone\'s processor cannot run the app version that was sent.
Not enough free space on this phone.
Type the 6-digit code shown in Settings. Drag the code line to move this pad.

Allow VegamShare to display over other apps, and a small number pad appears at the top of Settings while the pairing code stays visible below it. Nothing to remember.\n\nWithout it, the code is typed into the VegamShare notification.
